prompts.name: linen
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single flat full-bleed portrait journal cover background, requested final format 2185x3130 pixels, aspect ratio 18.5:26.5. Style: warm ivory linen and handmade paper, subtle woven fibers, restrained embossed thin rectangular frame with generous margins, a tiny pressed olive twig at bottom, refined quiet archival journal. Universal for travel and everyday life. Upper and central area (x 15-85%, y 18-60%) intentionally calm and empty for separately rendered editable title. No text, no letters, no logos, no dates, no people, no photo slots. Not a book mockup: no perspective, spine, leather shell, shadows outside sheet, or desk. Fine tasteful print-ready detail with safe margins; illustration can extend through edges. Return just one cover artwork.
